रीति f. (-तिः-ती)
 1. Usage, custom, practice, local or traditionary ob-
servance.
 2. Oozing, leaking, distilling.
 3. Brass, pale-brass, or
prince's metal.
 4. Rust of iron.
 5. Calx of brass.
 6. Scoria of any
metal, or the oxide formed on the surface of metals by their ex-
posure to heat and air.
 7. Boundary, limit.
 8. Going, motion.
 9.
Natural property or disposition.
 10. A stream, a river.
 11. Style,
diction; they are:--वैदर्भी, गौडी, पाञ्चाली and लाटिका or मागधी ।
E. री to go, to run out, &c. aff. क्तिच् ।

रीतिका f. (-का) Clax of brass.
 E. रीति brass, and कन् aff.

रीतिपुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Calx of brass.
 E. रीति brass, and पुष्प a flower.
